messages:
sam: deploy-bot raised an autorevert for embeddings-route after today's rollout. p95 jumped ~180ms and error rate ticked up. requesting quick ops decision: auto revert or human review?

deploy-bot: ALERT: autorevert candidate
route: embeddings-route
p95 +180ms (baseline 90ms)
errors +0.25%
suggested_action: autorevert -> v2.0.1

nina: hmm borderline. errors small but sustained. i'd rather do human review: pin prior version and shift 25% traffic for 10m while we watch.

ops_oncall: agree with human-in-the-loop. propose concrete thresholds: if p95 > +150ms AND errors > +0.3% for 8m -> full revert. suppression authorized by ops for 10m.

sam: pinning v2.0.1 and suppressing autorevert now, will apply 25% tilt once ops confirms.

deploy-bot: pinned v2.0.1 by sam. autorevert suppressed until 1719999480.

trent: applying split: `redwood rollout split --route embeddings-route --from v2.1.0 --to v2.0.1 --percent 25` -> started.

nina: 4m after tilt: p95 delta reduced to +60ms, errors 0.15%. looks better.

ops_oncall: leaving suppression in place. if thresholds cross, we perform full revert and update release notes. otherwise unpin at end of window and continue rollout.

sam: noted. monitoring and will post status updates.
